title: Negating machine output
statement: Given a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine, form a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine with the same number of ordinary work tapes, states, initial state, query state, and answer states. For every transition, preserve its input-head movement, work-tape actions, and successor state, and replace each emitted output bit by its Boolean negation; the three distinguished states remain pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean oracle Turing machine, whose query and answer states are pairwise distinct
